Maze of Doors.name: Maze of Doors
Maze of Doors.description: For the rest of the scene the user ties every doorway, hatch and window in a building to their Quirk and decides where each one leads. Enemies who pass through any of them come out where the user chooses, such as a locked room, the roof or the front steps, while allies and evacuees step from any door straight to safety; only breaking through a wall gets around it. Strain: severe.
